title: Presentability of strongly saturated fixed-source arrow categories
statement: Use presentable infinity categories and universes as in [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and coherent diagrams, mapping spaces and coslices as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be presentable and $S$ a small set of its arrows. Let $W$ be the smallest replete strongly saturated class containing $S$: it contains all equivalences, is closed under pushouts, is closed under all small colimits of diagrams of arrows in $\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal C)$, and has the two-out-of-three property for composable arrows. For every object $X\in\mathcal C$, the full subcategory $\mathcal D_X\subset\mathcal C_{X/}$ on the arrows $X\to Y$ belonging to $W$ is accessible and admits all small colimits, hence is presentable. Here $\mathcal C_{X/}$ retains coherent commuting triangles and their higher homotopies, rather than being the undercategory of the ordinary homotopy category.
